caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing human figure placed on a rectangular pedestal. The figure is facing to the right and is wearing a short blue tunic trimmed with yellow at the hem and sleeves, with a brownish-pink shawl draped over one shoulder and arm. The figure’s right arm is bent and positioned across the chest, while the left arm hangs down at the side. The figure is adorned with several pieces of jewelry, including bracelets on both wrists, bands on the upper arms, an elaborate necklace, and bands around the lower legs. The head is topped with a headdress made up of large, grayish feathers that are arranged in a fan shape with a green band at the base. The figure's sandals are brown with yellow straps. The pedestal is gray and square, with visible wood grain texture, and it is set against a plain, beige background.
